description: Hotels for a multi-stop trip, one stay per destination in travel order (e.g. Lisbon 4 nights, Porto 3, Madrid 5): the best match for each stop by the OKstays Comfort Score (or the travel style's score), alternatives, the stay dates and an indicative total. Each hotel link opens its OKstays page with the stop's dates, so its Book Now button books those nights. Agree the stops and nights with the user first; list_cities shows which destinations of a country we cover.

max_price.description: Maximum indicative price per night in USD.

persona.description: Travel style for every stop: digital-nomad, deep-sleep, avoid-crowds, romantic, family, business, solo-safe, luxury, budget-comfort.

start_date.description: Check-in date of the first stop, YYYY-MM-DD; each stop starts when the one before ends. Without it, no dates are set.

location.description: City name or slug, as in search_hotels.

tags.description: Filters every hotel must score 8+ on, as in search_hotels.

name: plan_trip
